name: mediagrabber-extension
description: Browser extension for downloading online videos with quality selection

scripts.build: tsc && esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/background.js && esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/content.js && esbuild src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/popup.js
scripts.watch: tsc --watch & esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/background.js --watch & esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/content.js --watch & esbuild src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/popup.js --watch
